candidates.title: Metro operator and workforce union dispute staffing terms for automated line
candidates.search_snippet: The operator and workforce union dispute staffing terms affecting the automated metro line.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic labour and operations notice. The metro operator and workforce union dispute staffing terms for an automated line. The dispute concerns control-room staffing, safety responsibilities, and the operating plan; the parties published their competing positions and next procedural step.

contract_notes: A dispute is reportable here because it has direct urban-rail operational and safety-governance significance.
A generic delay or passenger complaint would not satisfy this contract purpose.
